title: Unauthorised access reported to cooling system of Alpija cured-meat store in Tolmin, Slovenia
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its 27 November publication.
summary: Open reports that hackers raised the temperature of refrigerators and cold rooms at the Alpija agricultural company in Tolmin, Slovenia, which stored cured meats worth 250mila euro. Open says the cooling-system screen showed a photo of Matteo Salvini with the caption "Dovete ringraziare zio Matteo". Open reports that Nova Gorica police suspect unauthorized access to the remote management system; it says no one has claimed the attack.
plain: Open reports hackers raised the temperature in the cold rooms of a cured-meat store in Tolmin, Slovenia. Police suspect unauthorized access to the remote management system. No one has claimed it, Open says.
exec: Open reports a cooling system holding cured meats worth 250mila euro was tampered with remotely; police suspect unauthorized access and no one has claimed it.

evidence.quote: Gli hacker hanno alzato la temperatura di frigoriferi e celle frigo che contenevano salumi dal valore di 250mila euro.

validation.note: Only Open Online was read; zazoom.it and cedarnews.net are rewrites of it. Open cites 24ur.com and Nova Gorica police, whose pages were not read.

review.note: figure: evidence was an English paraphrase; replaced with the Italian sentence word for word and wrote the figure as the source does (250mila euro) in summary and exec
